claims.statement: The American Clinical Neurophysiology Society publishes minimum technical requirements for EEG recording and multiple standards covering electrode placement, digital recording, and reporting.

Published EEG research notes that artifacts can substantially contaminate recordings, that quality varies across subjects, and that objective standardized quality assessment supports more reproducible multi-site data.
Hypothesis: small studios and research teams will pay for auditable signal-quality evidence that reduces unusable sessions and differentiates their technical process without making clinical claims.

contrary_evidence: Open-source EEG preprocessing and quality tools may satisfy technically capable research labs.
Signal quality does not establish the efficacy of neurofeedback or the clinical validity of any interpretation.

economics.acquisition_route: Hypothesis: free local quality report on de-identified exports, then vendor/trainer bundles that make the check part of session closure.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 40 sites in year 2, 250 in year 4, and 900 sites/devices in year 6 at 1500 PLN monthly blended revenue yields 16.2M PLN ARR. At 3-5x ARR and 60% founder ownership, founder equity can exceed 5M PLN if the non-diagnostic wedge earns vendor distribution.
economics.founder_time: Hypothesis: 12-18 hours/week for pipeline development and customer QA, with qualified reviewers contracted per flagged batch.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 72-85% after compute, encrypted storage, and sampled expert review; fully manual review is excluded from the base offer.
economics.payback: Hypothesis: 3-7 months at 2000-5000 PLN acquisition cost and 1000-2500 PLN monthly account revenue.
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 15-35 PLN per session or 699-1999 PLN/month by device count and reviewer volume.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Hypothesis: session-level repetition and technician/device drift alerts support monthly use; target annual logo retention above 85% after integration.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Reviewed cross-device artifact corpus linked to technician, protocol, environment, remediation, and usable-session outcome
fingerprint.customer: European neurofeedback studios, cognitive research labs, and small wearable-EEG study teams
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Wearable-EEG vendors, neurofeedback training providers, BIDS-compatible research workflows, and reproducibility reports
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Automated integrity checks, reviewer queue, transparent session credential, and device/site benchmark SaaS
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Studio or lab pays per processed session or monthly monitored-seat/device license
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A recording ends, a batch is prepared for analysis, or a site/device quality drift is suspected

founder_fit: Unusually close fit with the founder's neuroscience, EEG, and data-science training.
Can build on open formats and synthetic/public recordings before accepting sensitive data.
Technical distribution through device vendors and training programs reduces personal-brand dependence.
A repeated quality score creates a scalable data asset rather than manual EEG interpretation.
risks: Customers could misrepresent a signal-integrity credential as clinical efficacy or diagnosis.
Sensitive biosignal and participant metadata require rigorous consent and de-identification.
Expert-review cost may prevent attractive margins at low session volume.

structure.control_point: device-neutral signal-integrity record and reviewed artifact benchmark
structure.critical_dependency: reliable automated QA with a strictly controlled clinical-claims boundary

thesis: A vendor-neutral quality-control layer for non-diagnostic neurofeedback studios and research labs. It scores electrode, channel, artifact, protocol, and annotation integrity, produces a session credential with transparent limits, and learns device- and technician-specific failure patterns from repeated reviewed recordings.
title: EEG Signal Integrity Credential for Neurofeedback and Research
uncertainties: The initial beachhead should be research/non-diagnostic quality control; medical-device implications need specialist review.
Device export formats, annotations, and ground-truth reviewer agreement may limit automation.
The 50000 PLN capital estimate and all pricing, adoption, payback, and valuation figures below are planning hypotheses.
